verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents native triggers for thousands of connected apps (new record/message events), plus Schedule, Email, HTTP/Webhook, and RSS triggers, with test-event simulation and automatic retries/error handling for reliability — directly matching the ops story of triggering workflows from app events. Community feedback corroborates real-world use for exactly this kind of integration automation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of specific 'new record' triggers across many named apps beyond docs claims.
